subject: SIG Questionnaire: module mapping + proposed owners
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finwave.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG Request: initial questionnaire attached

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we need a completed SIG questionnaire to progress our security review. I've attached the questionnaire (SIG_Questionnaire_FinWave_v1.xlsx) and highlighted the sections FinWave teams typically validate first (Network, Data Flow, Access Controls, Vendor Management).

Could you confirm who on your side will be the point owners for each SIG section and a rough ETA for initial responses (we're hoping for a first pass within 10 business days)? Also, please include a single index (spreadsheet or simple CSV) mapping question IDs to evidence file names if possible — that speeds review.

Elena
Elena Torres
Senior Security Program Manager | FinWave
elena.torres@finwave.com

--- Attachment: SIG_Questionnaire_FinWave_v1.xlsx (excel/xlsx, 1 file)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Request: initial questionnaire attached

Elena — thanks for sending. We can own this.

Quick plan: I want to triage the questionnaire into four module buckets (Network, Identity & Access, Data Lifecycle, Vendor/Controls) and assign primary and backup owners for each. Marissa, can you take the Data Lifecycle bucket (policy + retention + deletion evidence)? Mina, can you take Identity & Access (IAM, RBAC, SSO logs)? Ben — can you own Network & Infrastructure (VPC topology, firewall config, network segmentation evidence)? I will own Vendor/Controls and coordinate the index mapping back to your workbook.

I'll draft a one-page owner heatmap and a simple index template and share in the next 2 business days. If that timeline works, can you confirm whether we should upload evidence into the Drive folder linked below or send as a password-protected archive to your security mailbox?

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSIG-FinWave

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@finwave.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Request: initial questionnaire attached

Thanks Sean — good split. I've started a quick owner heatmap (attached) that maps SIG section IDs to owners and notes where we have immediate evidence versus where we'll need artifacts pulled from internal systems (logs, config, policy). A few quick notes: 

- Data Lifecycle: I have the retention policy PDF and deletion runbook, but we'll need Legal to sign off on redaction for the customer-facing artifact.
- IAM: Mina, can you confirm whether session logs for the last 90 days are accessible via our SIEM export? If not, list the queries you need and I'll coordinate with Platform Ops.
- Network: Ben, please capture an exported VPC diagram and the firewall rule snapshot; we'll also include a short narrative about how we isolate inference clusters from customer data paths.

I'll convert the heatmap into the index template that Elena requested and populate as much as I can. Tentative ETA for the initial bundle: EOD Wednesday (2026-06-17) for the first-pass evidence index; finalizing artifacts on rolling cadence after that.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

--- Attachment: owner_heatmap_v1.csv (csv, 1 file)

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Request: initial questionnaire attached

Copy that — I'll own Network & Infrastructure. Action items I picked up:
- Export VPC topology diagram (svg/pdf)
- Snapshot of firewall/security group rules (csv)
- Short narrative (1-2 paragraphs) describing isolation between inference GPU pools and customer data ingress

I'll start pulling artifacts this evening and will drop the files into the Drive folder mentioned by Sean unless Elena asks for a different channel. If Platform Ops needs an owner to approve access to the exports, @Mina please confirm.

Thanks — Ben
